rpi.label: Research-reproduced RPI
blockers: Official reference specifies category points and averaging but leaves precision intervals (DO 4.5–4.6, BOD5 4.9–5.0, SS 49.9–50.0, NH3-N 0.99–1.00) unresolved for arbitrary decimal inputs.
The applicable official laboratory significant-digit and RPI rounding rule has not been independently admitted. No rounding or detection-limit substitution is invented.
Same station-month CSV fields establish a published monthly record, not an independently verified common sampling event. No official RPI value was matched.

modeB.scope: Limited same-label exact monthly differences; historical physical continuity and sampling method remain unverified.

blockers: No permit or official compliance determination

comparison.explanation: The exact eligible candidate IDs are identical. Selection changes reflect strategy or capacity under the supplied scope.

latestYearOnly.explanation: Eligibility populations differ. Changes reflect scope or evidence rules as well as selection; this is not an equivalent-population strategy comparison.

capacity10.explanation: The exact eligible candidate IDs are identical. Selection changes reflect strategy or capacity under the supplied scope.

limitations: Monthly station records support documentary evidence review only. They do not establish causality, regulatory compliance, drinking-water safety, ecological harm or current conditions.

Expected periods assume the published monthly schedule across the admitted years. Station commissioning/discontinuation and historical physical continuity are unknown; missing rows do not prove closure.

The current month is an observation opportunity still in progress; its empty rows are neither future placeholders nor overdue historical samples. Future months are excluded from expected-to-date denominators.

Current official label matching does not establish unchanged historical physical monitoring location or laboratory methodology. Strict Mode B has no admitted comparisons. Limited pairs describe exact same-label monthly differences only, not validated trends or significance.
Censored values preserve detection limits without substitution. No ordinary mean mixes exact and censored observations. No station coordinates are admitted and no policy map pins are generated.
Complete four-indicator inputs are potential inputs only; research RPI remains unavailable pending precision, rounding and common-sampling evidence.
